item.description:
大小：89.5GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




咒术回战 / Jujutsu Kaisen / 呪術廻戦 S1 + S2 + MOVIE BDRip Reseed v2

第二季内封原盘 JPN 字幕。剧场版内封原盘 ENG + JPN 字幕。
S2 embedded official JPN PGS. The MOVIE embedded official ENG + JPN PGS.
剧场版外挂 FLAC 5.1、无障碍音轨和评论音轨。
The MOVIE has an external MKA with FLAC 5.1, audio description and commentary track.

这个项目与 豌豆字幕组 和 风之圣殿 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with BeanSub & FZSD. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

整体画质较好，仅在部分场景零星出现锯齿，我们使用自适应 AA 对这部分锯齿进行处理，并补偿了 AA 造成的锐度损失。由于剧中暗场画面较多，覆盖了较为细密，且强度较高的噪点。对此我们使用了较强的自适应降噪参数与抗色带处理以削减成品体积。
The overall image quality is quite good, with only occasional aliasing in some scenes. We addressed this with adaptive anti-aliasing (AA) and compensated for the sharpness loss caused by AA. The series contains many dark scenes with dense and intense noise. We used strong adaptive denoising parameters and anti-banding to reduce the final file size.

重发修正：
1. 修正部分字幕；
2. 移除未使用的字体；
3. 调整部分特典的命名；
4. 按现行规范重新整理 CD；
5. 新增收录 S2 OST 的实体版本, 替换 Web 版本；
6. 新增收录 S2 USA BD 扫图。

Reseed comment:
1. Fixed some subtitles;
2. Removed unused fonts;
3. Adjusted the naming of some bonus content;
4. Reorganized the CDs according to current standards;
5. Added the physical version of the S2 OST, replacing the web version;
6. Added the S2 USA BD scans.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] SANDA 变身圣诞老人 / SANDA 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：18.5GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




SANDA 变身圣诞老人 / SANDA BDRip

内封原盘 JPN 字幕。
Embedded official JPN PGS.
部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

Frontier Works 出品的 BD 在编码质量上一向表现出色，加之本片噪点细腻，因此除锯齿外，制作与编码层面基本无明显瑕疵。不过，本片在 BD 版本灌录前遭遇了低通滤波（lowpass）的荼毒，虽然强度不高，但多数高频细节仍受到波及，尤其 ED 为风格化制作，锐度极高，画面细节基本全损，我们以 AMZN 源为参照对 ED 进行了针对性修复。正片部分则因科学猴的画面风格对这类后期操作具有天然抗性，总体影响不大，仅作基础处理。
此外，本片 OP 风格极为狂暴，画面为红、白、黑三色强烈碰撞，同时伴有高动态变换和大量密集的细节特效。好在 Frontier Works 的优质编码即使在如此激进的画面下仍保留了大部分细节，反观 AMZN 源画质已严重劣化，无法作为参考，因此我们只能直接以 BD 为基础进行多轮修复，尽可能消除各类瑕疵。
Frontier Works BDs consistently have good encoding quality, and the grain in this anime is also fine. As a result, aside from aliasing, there are basically no obvious artifacts in the production or encoding. However, the source for the BD version goes through lowpass filtering before mastering. Although the filtering is not very strong, it still affects most high-frequency details. The ED in particular uses a highly stylised art style and has extremely high sharpness, so most of its image details are lost. We therefore carry out targeted restoration of the ED using the AMZN source as a reference. As for the main feature, Science SARU's art style is naturally resistant to this kind of PP, so the overall impact is limited and only basic processing is applied.
In addition, the OP has an extremely aggressive art style, with strong clashes between red, white, and black. It also features rapid changes and a large amount of dense detail and effects. Fortunately, Frontier Works' high-quality encoding still preserves most of the details even in such an extreme presentation. In contrast, the AMZN source is already severely degraded and cannot be used as a reference. Therefore, we use the BD directly as the basis for multiple rounds of restoration, removing as many artifacts as possible.

压制 / Encode: 冬村 四織
整理 / Collate: 小野 一会

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 魔王2099 / Demon Lord 2099 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：20.7GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




魔王2099 / Demon Lord 2099 BDRip

原盘画质中等偏下。线条锐度较高，带有较强的振铃；色度平面存在色度锯齿，在多数红色场景明显可见；部分暗场有可见色带。
The source exhibits subpar image quality, characterized by sharp lines, significant ringing, aliasing in chroma planes (prominent in red scenes), and visible banding in partial dark scenes.

我们对线条使用了较强的去振铃和较弱的抗锯齿处理，并进行了较弱的补偿性锐化来提升观感；对平面则进行了去色带处理和自适应降噪，并对色度平面进行了重构。
Strong de-ringing and mild anti-aliasing were applied to the lines, complemented by mild compensatory sharpening to enhance visual performance. For flat areas, de-banding, adaptive denoising, and chroma plane reconstruction were performed.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 深夜重拳 / Mayonaka Punch / 真夜中ぱんチ 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：22.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




深夜重拳 / Mayonaka Punch / 真夜中ぱんチ BDRip

第 11、12 话内封 AAC 评论音轨。
Episodes 11 and 12 contain embedded AAC commentary tracks.

P.A.Works 又奖励了自己一部原创番，制作水平优良，细节详实，动态丰富。可惜原盘编码有所欠缺，各场景有程度不一的欠码，重噪重特效的 OP 直接原地去世。考虑到全片只有 OP 部分的重噪有明确意义，我们留存了 OP 噪点层，其余部分则采取了积极降噪的处理思路，同时兼顾细节和码率，并减少编码瑕疵。
P.A.Works has once again rewarded itself with an original anime featuring excellent production quality, rich detail, and plenty of motion. Unfortunately, the source encode is somewhat lacking: different scenes suffer from insufficient bitrate to varying degrees, and the OP, with its heavy grain and intense effects, is simply dead on arrival. Since the OP is the only part of the anime where the heavy grain serves a clear purpose, we retained the OP's grain layer. For the rest of the anime, we adopted an aggressive denoising approach while balancing detail against bitrate and reducing encoding artifacts.

item.description:

五等分的新娘∬ / Go-Toubun no Hanayome S2 / 五等分の花嫁∬ BDRip Reseed

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

虽然换了制作公司，原盘画质并没有比第一季更好。线条锐度较高，且伴有大量振铃和锯齿。平面上覆盖着细腻的噪点，然而并没有盖住细腻的色带，同帧内存在亮度剧变时就能看到类似波纹的明显细色带。我们在去色带、抗锯齿之外，尽可能地去除了振铃对观感造成的影响，最后是补偿性锐化和自适应降噪。
Although the production company changed, the quality of the source is not better than the first season. The lines are sharply defined, accompanied by a significant amount of ringing and aliasing. The flat areas are covered with fine noise, yet this does not obscure the delicate color banding, which becomes evident as wave-like bands in scenes with dramatic changes in brightness. In addition to de-banding and anti-aliasing, we made every effort to minimize the visual impact of ringing. The final touches were compensatory sharpening and adaptive denoising.

重发修正：
1. 修复正片第一话的花屏问题；
2. 按照现行规范重新整理专辑；
3. 调整部分特典命名。

3. Renamed some SPs.

item.title: [诸神字幕组&VCB-Studio] 能干的猫今天也忧郁 / Dekiru Neko wa Kyou mo Yuuutsu / デキる猫は今日も憂鬱 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：14.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




能干的猫今天也忧郁 / Dekiru Neko wa Kyou mo Yuuutsu / デキる猫は今日も憂鬱 BDRip

这个项目与 诸神字幕组 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Kamigami. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

《能干猫》是一个相当棘手的项目。由于正片共 13 话被塞进 4 张 BD25，源视频码率偏低，导致画面出现较为明显的色带瑕疵。所幸制作方未加入过多噪点，除部分光污染严重的动态场景外，欠码问题大致仍在可应对范围内。
片中大量弱纹理与光照特效的使用，虽然体现了 GoHands 制作的用心，但也反过来带来了挑战。由于强色带与水彩风格纹理在视觉上高度相似，常常难以判断眼前所见究竟是真实细节，还是压缩造成的伪影。我们最终选择了保守的色带处理策略，以尽量避免误伤画面的真实内容。
Dekineko was a rather tricky anime to work on. With all 13 episodes crammed onto four BD25 discs, the source video has a low bitrate, resulting in fairly noticeable color banding. Fortunately, the anime doesn't have too much grain, so the insufficient bitrate is generally manageable, except in some dynamic scenes with intense lighting effects.
This anime makes extensive use of low-contrast textures and lighting effects. While this reflects the care GoHands put into the anime, it also presents a challenge: severe banding can look remarkably similar to watercolor-style textures, making it difficult to determine whether what we are seeing is genuine detail or an encoding artifact. We ultimately adopted a conservative debanding strategy to avoid damaging genuine image detail as much as possible.

总监：对付 GoHands 的最好办法，就是让他们画一只全黑的猫。
整理：建议打开防蓝光食用

item.description:
大小：10.8GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




名侦探柯南 独眼的残像 / Detective Conan M28: One-eyed Flashback / 名探偵コナン 隻眼の残像 BDRip

内封原盘 JPN 字幕。
Embedded official JPN PGS.
外挂 FLAC 5.1、评论音轨和无障碍音轨。
MKA contains FLAC 5.1, commentary tracks, and audio description.

这个项目与 银色子弹字幕组 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with SBSUB. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

可能是由于制作流程变化，本作色带问题较以往更为严重。全片几乎所有纯色场景都出现了大范围的色带，而噪点的缺失使得这些色带更为明显。另外，由于本作有大量黑暗场景，更加剧了色带的影响。而另一方面，本作在所有的非纯色场景都保持了非常高的清晰度。尤其是在线条部分，几乎没有发现锯齿。
我们使用了非常高强度的去色带和降噪处理，用来解决色带问题，以及色带所附带的烂噪。我们在纹理区域还原了噪点层，以避免降噪带来的锐度损失。为了避免片中出现未被发现的锯齿，我们使用了较为保守的 AA 处理作为保险措施。
Possibly due to changes in the production process, the banding issue in this movie is more severe than before. Nearly all flat color scenes throughout the film exhibit widespread banding, and the absence of grain makes banding even more noticeable. Moreover, the film contains a large number of dark scenes, which further amplifies the impact of the banding. On the other hand, all non-flat color scenes in this work maintain very high sharpness. In particular, almost no aliasing can be found along the lines.
We applied very strong de-banding and denoising to address the banding issue and the grain blocking associated with it. We restored the noise layer in textured areas to avoid sharpness loss caused by denoising. To ensure no overlooked aliasing remains in the frame, we used relatively conservative anti-aliasing as a precaution.

圣女因太过完美一点也不讨人喜欢而被废除婚约卖到邻国 BDRip
Kanpekisugite Kawaige ga Nai to Konyaku Haki sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru BDRip
完璧すぎて可愛げがないと婚約破棄された聖女は隣国に売られる BDRip

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

原盘原始编码质量欠佳，加之灌流前的额外后期工序，使得 BD 画面出现了 WEB 配信源所没有的多层振铃效应与色度细节损失。全片原生分辨率约 900，尽管画风天然抗编码，但因细节丰富，全片仍有不少欠码。我们参考 CR 源对 BD 进行修复，随后做了基础的抗锯齿和去振铃处理。
The source's original encoding quality is poor. Additional post-processing before BD mastering also introduces multi-layered ringing and a loss of chroma detail into the image — issues the WEB source does not have. The native resolution throughout the anime is about 900. Although the art style is naturally well-suited fot encoding, the sheer amount of detail means the anime still suffers from insufficient bitrate in many scenes. We use the CR source as a reference to restore the BD, then apply basic anti-aliasing and de-ringing.

item.description:

乡下大叔成为剑圣 / Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru / 片田舎のおっさん、剣聖になる S1 BDRip

全片制作水准尚可，纹理丰富，线条锐利。同时画面覆有一层静噪，编码质量也属合格。总体没有太多需要处理的地方，唯有 OP 部分那报仇雪恨的噪点存在明显欠码，我们已尽可能修复以优化观感。同时为保留更多画面细节，我们调整了参数并提高了码率预算。
The source is of good quality, characterized by abundant texture and sharp lines, with the frames covered by a layer of static noise and an acceptable encoding quality. In general, the source requires minimal pre-processing, except for the OP suffering from notably insufficient bitrate due to heavy noise, which has been fixed as much as possible to improve the view. We also adjusted parameters and increased the bitrate target to preserve more detail.

item.title: [茉语星梦&风之圣殿&VCB-Studio] Princess Principal / 公主代理人 / プリンセス・プリンシパル 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [TV Reseed Fin]
item.description:
大小：19.9GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




公主代理人 / Princess Principal / プリンセス・プリンシパル BDRip Reseed

内封评论音轨。
Embedded commentary track.

这个项目与 茉语星梦 和 风之圣殿 合作，感谢字幕组的精心制作的字幕和设定解说集。
This project is in collaboration with MakariHoshiyume & FZSD. Thanks to them for elaborating Chinese subtitles and settings book.

Princess Principal 的原盘画质非常差，大概是为了配合剧中时代背景，整个画面看上去很陈旧，看着像一部上古 DVD，有效分辨率不到 720p。原盘画面中，线条粗细不均，还有锯齿和断线问题，线条周围有明显的振铃瑕疵，平面区域有色带。画面修复方面，我对线条进行抗锯齿、线条加深、连线、去振铃处理，对平面进行去色带和纹理增强，让画面看起来更清晰。说实话，这部片的画面处理确实非常麻烦。为了让线条看起来稍微平滑和清晰一些，我耗费大量时间，专门为其折腾了一种连线和线条加深手段。希望有生之年不会再碰到这种返古的原盘，如果有……那就让别人去背这口锅吧……至于来年的剧场版，我们有缘再见吧 T^T
by 静流的抱枕
The picture quality of Princess Principal's Blu-ray is quite awful, and looks medieval, perhaps trying to match up with the historical background of the story. It resembles an ancient DVD where the effective resolution is lower than 720p. For example, the thickness of lines is uneven, together with aliasing and discontinuity. There are strong ringing artifacts near the lines and bandings in the flat area. In order to fix the artifacts, we applied anti-aliasing, line-darkening, broken-line-connection and de-ringing. Furthermore we applied de-banding and texture-enhancement to the flat areas to increase the overall clarity of the picture. It is tough to make lines smoother and more clarified, for which I spend a long time to design a method to connect broken lines and darken them. Hopefully I would never encounter such source in the future and if there is... let someone else deal with it... As for the theatrical version in the upcoming year, I'll see you again if it deems fit.

重发修正：
1. 合并 SP10 补充的 OST 扫图；
2. 删除 readme about WebP.txt；
3. 修正正片章节缺失的语言标签；
4. 移除多余字体、补充缺失字体并重新打包；
5. 调整 EP03 设定解说的命名；
6. 按照现行规范调整特典视频位置；
7. 新增收录设定资料集；
8. 新增收录 Hi-Res 版 OST；
9. 按照现行规范重新整理 CD。

Reseed comment:
1. Merged the OST scans supplemented by SP10;
2. Removed readme about WebP.txt;
3. Fixed the missing language tags in the main feature chapters;
4. Removed redundant fonts, added missing fonts, and repacked the font pack;
5. Adjusted the naming of the EP03 settings book;
6. Rearranged the bonus videos location according to current standards;
7. Added the Official Setting Documents Collection Spy and Seek;
8. Added the Hi-Res version OST to the release;
9. Reorganized the CDs according to current standards.

item.description:

南家三姐妹 / Minami-ke / みなみけ S2-S4 + OADs Rev + S1 Reseed BDRip

S4 内封评论音轨。
Embedded commentary track within S4.

本次重制我们重新制作了了第二季，第三季，第四季以及部分 OVA。原盘画质很差，具体画质评价可以参考之前的版本。这次重制主要优化了烂边，噪点和画面比例相关的处理，并使用了 DVD 源以及无损坏的 BD 源来修复部分集数的花屏问题。值得一提的是出于切黑边后最小化内容损失和保持原比例的考虑，第三季的最终分辨率是 1920x1078。第二季，第三季，第四季各四组对比图。
This rework covers S2, S3, S4, and partial OVAs. The source exhibits terrible image quality, as noted in our previous comments. This rework focuses on pre-processing of the dirty edges, noise, and aspect ratio, while fixing the corrupted frames in certain episodes using the DVD source and undamaged BD source. In order to minimize content loss after cropping the black borders and maintain the original aspect ratio, the final resolution of S3 is 1920x1078. Four sets of comparison images are provided for S2, S3, and S4, respectively.

总监：期待第五季！

item.description:
大小：43.8GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




超自然武装当哒当 / 胆大党 / Dandadan / ダンダダン S1-S2 BDRip

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

本番由 组员提名，应要求制作。感谢他们为 VCB-Studio 发展做出的无私奉献。
This project was nominated by our members and produced upon request. Thanks to them for their selfless dedication to the development of VCB-Studio.

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

粗犷的线条、厚重的噪点、浓烈的色彩与略带复古感的画风，共同构成了本片别具一格的视觉质感。可惜过重的噪点对画质有较为明显的负面影响，经编码后产生了明显的烂噪，同时画面中还有欠码造成的块状瑕疵。我们也参考了 CR 片源，存在同样的问题。此外，BD 版在修正部分场景作画的同时，还消除了一部分未润线的二值化锯齿。
综合考量本片的锐度、细节、噪点、画面修正等因素后，我们仍选用 BD 版进行制作，尽可能修复了画面中的色块和烂噪，对线条做了基础处理，最后适当削减一部分噪点以控制文件体积。不过本片打戏密集、特效量极大，因此成片体积依旧偏大，属于正常情况。
The rough lines, heavy grain, intense colors, and a slightly retro art style together create the distinctive visual texture of this anime. Unfortunately, the excessive grain noticeably degrades the image quality after encoding, resulting in obvious DCT noise, along with blocking from insufficient bitrate. We also checked the Crunchyroll source, which had the same issues. Additionally, BD version corrected some scenes, it also removed some raw binary aliasing for a smooth look.
After carefully considering factors such as sharpness, detail, grain, and artwork corrections, we still chose the BD version for production. We repaired the blocking and poor noise in the image as much as possible, applied basic line processing, and finally moderately reduced the grain to control file size. That said, the anime features dense fight scenes and heavy special effects, so the final file size is still quite large, which is normal.

item.title: [喵萌奶茶屋&VCB-Studio] 迷宫饭 / Dungeon Meshi / ダンジョン飯 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [S1 Fin]
item.description:
大小：50.3GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




迷宫饭 / Dungeon Meshi / ダンジョン飯 BDRip

外挂 FLAC 5.1。
MKA contains FLAC 5.1.

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

原盘画质表现一般，原生分辨率约为 900p。多数画面上覆盖了一层静噪，部分场景中噪点下还夹带着色带。原盘的主要问题在于手绘线条同时存在锯齿与振铃。我们采用了逆向拉伸、抗锯齿与抑制振铃的处理，并在修复线条时辅以保守性限制与补偿性锐化，以尽量保留其手绘风格。最后再进行常规的自适应去色带。
影片中暗场较多，我们剥离了噪点层，并根据不同的动态与场景自适应调整，以在合适的码率下维持整体观感。
The source quality is average, with a native resolution of around 900p. Most frames are covered with a layer of static noise, and in some scenes, color banding is lurking beneath the noise. The main issue with the source is that the hand-drawn lines exhibit both aliasing and ringing. We applied descaling, anti-aliasing, and de-ringing. When repairing the lines, we supplemented the process with conservative limiting and contra-sharpening to preserve the hand-drawn art style as much as possible. Finally, we performed routine adaptive de-banding.
Given the many dark scenes in the film, we stripped the noise layer and adaptively adjusted it based on different motion and scene characteristics, in order to maintain the overall visual impression at an appropriate bitrate.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 盾之勇者成名录 / Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari / 盾の勇者の成り上がり 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [S1-S2 Reseed Fin]
item.description:
大小：52.1GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




盾之勇者成名录 / Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari / 盾の勇者の成り上がり S1 + S2 BDRip Reseed

S1 部分剧集内封评论音轨。
S1: Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

两季度原盘画质都不错。第一季原生分辨率为 847p，第二季为 837p。线条有轻微的锯齿。画面覆盖了一层较高强度的噪点，虽然盖住了色带，但是也带来了不少烂噪。我们进行了逆向拉伸重构。然后对降噪后的画面进行色带评估，根据其结果进行了自适应去色带处理。然后我们削弱了原盘的烂噪，替换为同等强度的动态噪点以改善观感。最后为了控制体积，我们进行了自适应降噪。
第一季的第八集包含了大量的特效和超高强度噪点，如果完全保留原盘的噪点进行压制的话，这一集成品体积会达到 3.3GB。我们结合了神经网络算法和传统算法对重噪点片段进行了降噪，以分离出高频噪点和烂噪并尽量保留细节，并配合亮度自适应降噪以控制成品体积。
The source quality is good in both seasons, and the native resolution is 847p of S1 and 837p of S2. The image features relatively high-intensity noise, which covers up the colour banding but also introduces a fair amount of bad-encoded noise. Besides, there is also slight aliasing present around the lines. We first performed descaling and reconstruction, next evaluated the colour banding, and then based on its results adaptive de-banding was carried out. The bad-encoded noise was weakened afterwards and replaced with dynamic grains of equal intensity to improve the viewing experience. Finally, our PP ended with adaptive denoising.
S1E8 contains too many visual effects plus ultra-high-intensity noise, which would have resulted in a 3.3GB encoded video if we had retained all the noise during encoding. To solve this issue, we combined both neural network algorithm and traditional algorithm to denoise the cuts with heavy noise: separate high-frequency noise and bad-encoded noise and preserve as much detail as possible, then adopt adaptive denoising based on luminance to control the bitrate.

发布(西娅)：小浣熊无敌！

重发修正：
1. 删除第二季 SPs 目录下重复的 Menu 档案；
2. 调整部分特典的命名；
3. 按现行规范重新收集和整理 CD；
4. 添加第一季 BD 扫图。

Reseed comment:
1. Removed duplicate Menu files in the Season 2 SPs;
2. Renamed some special features;
3. Re-collected and re-collated CDs according to current standards;
4. Added Season 1 BD scans.

item.title: [SweetSub&VCB-Studio] 章鱼哔的原罪/章鱼噼的原罪 / Takopii no Genzai / タコピーの原罪 10-bit 1080p AV1 BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：9.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




章鱼哔的原罪/章鱼噼的原罪 / Takopii no Genzai / タコピーの原罪 BDRip

这个项目与 SweetSub 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with SweetSub. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

《章鱼噼的原罪》原盘整体没有太多瑕疵，但画面中的细腻动噪处理起来相当棘手。其视觉强度不上不下，同时又存在一定程度的欠码：如果保留原样，在 HEVC 编码下很难完整呈现；如果直接降噪，又会影响原本的画风。
在厨力的驱使下，我们在本项目中大胆改用了 AV1 格式，借助其噪点生成（FGS, Film Grain Synthesis）功能来解决噪点保留问题。通过分析 AV1 编码器的设计和特性，我们摸索出了一套更适配的参数组合，以及配套的后期处理逻辑，尽可能克服 AV1 格式在细节保留上“下限低，上限更低”的缺点。
在 FGS 方面，我们并未采用编码器自带的 --film-grain 功能，而是构建了新的工具链，用于提取原盘的噪点特征，并准确重现符合原本画风的噪点。
最终得到的画面效果让我们相信，本次投入的时间和精力是值得的。而且由于噪点是通过生成而非直接编码的方式保留，成品体积甚至也得到了一定优化。
以此项目为契机，我们也希望日后能有更多噪点番采用 AV1 + FGS 来克服技术困难，以更好的面貌呈现到大家面前。

The source of "Takopi's Original Sin" generally has few artifacts, but the fine dynamic noise remains quite tricky to process. Its visual intensity is moderate, and it suffers from some insufficient bitrate. If left unchanged, HEVC encoding struggles to reproduce it fully; if denoising is applied directly, it affects the original art style.
Driven by our passion, we boldly switch to the AV1 format in this project. We utilize its Film Grain Synthesis (FGS) feature to solve the noise retention issue. By analyzing the design and characteristics of the AV1 encoder, we discover a more suitable combination of parameters and corresponding PP logic. This helps us best overcome the AV1 format's flaw of having a "low floor, and an even lower ceiling" in detail retention.
For FGS, we do not use the encoder's built-in --film-grain feature. Instead, we build a new toolchain to extract the noise characteristics of the source and accurately reproduce noise that matches the original art style.
The final visual result proves that our invested time and effort are worthwhile. Moreover, since the noise is preserved through synthesis rather than direct encoding, the final file size is even optimized to some extent.
Using this project as an opportunity, we hope that more grainy anime adopt AV1 + FGS to overcome technical difficulties and present a better look to the audience.

item.title: [天香字幕社&VCB-Studio] 冰菓/冰果 / Hyouka / 氷菓 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Reseed Fin]
item.description:
大小：45.2GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




冰菓/冰果 / Hyouka / 氷菓 BDRip Reseed

内封评论音轨。
Embedded commentary track.

这个项目与 天香字幕社 和 悠风社 合作，正片字幕来自天香字幕社，Event02 佐藤聪美的高山市圣地巡礼的字幕来自悠风社，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with T.H.X. & Eupho. Thanks to T.H.X. for providing the main episodes, and Eupho for providing Event02 subtitles. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

时隔数年的冰菓 rework。这次全部内容都用 HEVC 重压，比起旧版本提高了画质定位，改善了很多处理手段。冰菓原盘的画质不错，线条清晰纹理丰富，但精良的画风掩盖之下有不少小问题：有些场景的色带很严重，丰富的噪点因为欠码而被压碎了，出现了小色块，线条有轻微锯齿和晕轮。针对这些特点，我们配合保护手段进行了抗锯齿、去色带、去晕轮和纹理增强，噪点基本都保留了下来，整体处理力度比较保守，并不惜码率用了高还原度的参数。
This is a rework of our previous Hyouka release. Four years have passed, and now we could re-encode everything with HEVC, with improved pre-processing and targeting higher quality standards. The Blu-ray source of Hyouka is decent, with clear line art and rich texture, but also has various small issues: some scenes have very heavy banding, grain blocking due to insufficient bit-rate, and slight aliasing/ringing in the line art. We applied masked anti-aliasing, debanding, deringing and texture enhancement to fix those issues, and kept most of the grains. Pre-processing is relatively conservative overall, and we used high quality HEVC parameters aiming for transparency.

冰菓重制是我从做片伊始就抱持的夙愿，因为实际上冰菓一直没有一个很让人满意的版本，包括 VCB-Studio 的旧版本，以现在的眼光来看其实还是不够好的。但由于我个人的产能原因一直拖着，一晃就是三年，直到今年七月的京阿尼大火事件，让我下定决心放下手中其他事，先把冰菓压出来。这次发布的是纪念作，参与制作的组员也都是京蜜，大家做得很用心，临近发布的时候因为发现了漏掉的瑕疵，又回炉重造，根据不同场景使用不同处理脚本分段重压了一遍。历时两个月，总算是了却一桩心愿。然而即使小说已经凑够了一季度的剧情，武本康弘监督、西屋太志作监以及许多其他社员却再也没有机会制作冰菓的第二季了。愿逝者安息。
by 静流的抱枕
Hyouka rework has been a long time wish of mine ever since I started as a ripper. Actually there has never been a very satisfying version of Hyouka BDrip, including the old version from VCB-Studio, considering all kinds of new techniques we have now. Due to the time contraints of mine, it has been three years until the KyouAni arson attack in July, I finally decided to put everything else aside and focus on this project. As a memorial project, all participating members of VCB-S are KyoAni fans, and everyone tried their best. A remaining banded scene was found after we almost finished everything, and we had to re-encode all main episodes with scene-specific filtering. The project took two months to finish, and this dream of mine has finally come true. However, even there is now enough stories to make up for a whole new season, director Yasuhiro Takemoto, chief animation director Futoshi Nishiya, along with many others from KyoAni won't be able to participate making the next season. May they rest in peace.
by Shizuru's Dakimakura

重发修正：
1. 删除 readme about WebP.txt；
2. 重新打包字体；

item.content:encoded:
冰菓/冰果 / Hyouka / 氷菓 BDRip Reseed

内封评论音轨。
Embedded commentary track.

这个项目与 天香字幕社 和 悠风社 合作，正片字幕来自天香字幕社，Event02 佐藤聪美的高山市圣地巡礼的字幕来自悠风社，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with T.H.X. & Eupho. Thanks to T.H.X. for providing the main episodes, and Eupho for providing Event02 subtitles. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

时隔数年的冰菓 rework。这次全部内容都用 HEVC 重压，比起旧版本提高了画质定位，改善了很多处理手段。冰菓原盘的画质不错，线条清晰纹理丰富，但精良的画风掩盖之下有不少小问题：有些场景的色带很严重，丰富的噪点因为欠码而被压碎了，出现了小色块，线条有轻微锯齿和晕轮。针对这些特点，我们配合保护手段进行了抗锯齿、去色带、去晕轮和纹理增强，噪点基本都保留了下来，整体处理力度比较保守，并不惜码率用了高还原度的参数。
This is a rework of our previous Hyouka release. Four years have passed, and now we could re-encode everything with HEVC, with improved pre-processing and targeting higher quality standards. The Blu-ray source of Hyouka is decent, with clear line art and rich texture, but also has various small issues: some scenes have very heavy banding, grain blocking due to insufficient bit-rate, and slight aliasing/ringing in the line art. We applied masked anti-aliasing, debanding, deringing and texture enhancement to fix those issues, and kept most of the grains. Pre-processing is relatively conservative overall, and we used high quality HEVC parameters aiming for transparency.

冰菓重制是我从做片伊始就抱持的夙愿，因为实际上冰菓一直没有一个很让人满意的版本，包括 VCB-Studio 的旧版本，以现在的眼光来看其实还是不够好的。但由于我个人的产能原因一直拖着，一晃就是三年，直到今年七月的京阿尼大火事件，让我下定决心放下手中其他事，先把冰菓压出来。这次发布的是纪念作，参与制作的组员也都是京蜜，大家做得很用心，临近发布的时候因为发现了漏掉的瑕疵，又回炉重造，根据不同场景使用不同处理脚本分段重压了一遍。历时两个月，总算是了却一桩心愿。然而即使小说已经凑够了一季度的剧情，武本康弘监督、西屋太志作监以及许多其他社员却再也没有机会制作冰菓的第二季了。愿逝者安息。
by 静流的抱枕
Hyouka rework has been a long time wish of mine ever since I started as a ripper. Actually there has never been a very satisfying version of Hyouka BDrip, including the old version from VCB-Studio, considering all kinds of new techniques we have now. Due to the time contraints of mine, it has been three years until the KyouAni arson attack in July, I finally decided to put everything else aside and focus on this project. As a memorial project, all participating members of VCB-S are KyoAni fans, and everyone tried their best. A remaining banded scene was found after we almost finished everything, and we had to re-encode all main episodes with scene-specific filtering. The project took two months to finish, and this dream of mine has finally come true. However, even there is now enough stories to make up for a whole new season, director Yasuhiro Takemoto, chief animation director Futoshi Nishiya, along with many others from KyoAni won't be able to participate making the next season. May they rest in peace.
by Shizuru's Dakimakura

原盘的画质一般。尽管线条锐度较好，背景纹理也很丰富，但受制于原盘不到 3GB 一集的体积，不可避免地出现了大量色带。对于线条部分我们主要应用了轻度的抗锯齿。而色带部分由于需要考虑对背景纹理的保护，我们首先对画面进行色带强度的评估，并根据评估结果进行力度自适应的去色带，最后对纹理部分补偿锐
The source is of mid quality. Even though the lines are sharp and the background texture is rich, there is lots of color banding because of the file size limitation (about 3GB per episode). To eliminate these problems, we first applied slight anti-aliasing to the lines. As for the color banding, our goal is to preserve the background texture when de-banding. To do so, we evaluated the intensity of the color banding, and adaptive de-banding was applied afterwards based on our evaluation results. Finally, we performed compensatory sharpening to the texture.

《欢迎来到实力至上主义教室》原盘画质一般，主要问题是色度平面上非常严重的锯齿。我们借助 Waifu2x 对色度平面的线条进行了重构，在不损失锐度的同时尽可能修复了这一问题。另外我们还修复了线条在亮度平面的轻微锯齿和晕轮，以及原盘制作时的拉伸在画面边缘产生的亮线。
The source quality is mediocre largely due to its severe chroma aliasing. We took advantage of Waifu2x to reconstruct the line art in the chroma planes to fix it without losing sharpness. Also, we have fixed some mild aliasing and ringing of the line art in the luma plane, as well as the bright lines around the image borders caused by upscaling in the source.

item.description:
大小：170.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




进击的巨人 / Shingeki no Kyojin / Attack on Titan / 進撃の巨人 S1-4 + OADs BDRip Reseed

这个项目与 动漫国字幕组 和 恶魔岛字幕组 和 豌豆字幕组 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with DMG & EMD & Beansub. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

本次发布的是《进击的巨人》TV 版与 OAD 的 BDRip 合集，包括了 TV 版 1-4 季度共 94 集（含完结篇）以及共 8 集 OAD。其他内容，包括各总集篇剧场版及 Live 活动的 BDRip，准备再等一等第四季总集篇剧场版 BD 发售之后一起发布。
本片原盘画质都还可以：有微弱锯齿和一些色带，第四季则额外有较为明显的晕轮。这些问题使用常规处理手段都可以较好地修复。
字幕方面，我们分别与动漫国字幕组&恶魔岛字幕组（第一季、OAD 01）、动漫国字幕组（第二季、OAD 04-05）、豌豆字幕组（第三季 Part.2、第四季、OAD 06-08）合作。感谢所有参与这些字幕制作的人们的辛勤劳动。遗憾的是，第三季前半当年就没有任何我们能联系到的字幕组开坑，而我们试图联系的其他字幕组都表示 OAD 02-03 的字幕原文件早已丢失，所以这部分的字幕就只好欠缺了。
This release is a BDRip collection of Shingeki no Kyojin, covering the TV series and OADs: Seasons 1-4 (94 episodes in total, including THE FINAL CHAPTERS) plus 8 OAD episodes. Other content—including the compilation film and the Live event BDRips—will be released together after the Season 4 compilation film BD is released.
The source looks fine overall: slight aliasing and some banding, and Season 4 additionally shows more noticeable haloing. These issues can be corrected well with routine post-processing.
For subtitles, we collaborated with DMG & EMD (Season 1; OAD 01), DMG (Season 2; OAD 04-05), and Beansub (Season 3 Part.2; Season 4; OAD 06-08). Many thanks to everyone who worked hard on these subtitles. Unfortunately, no group we could reach had taken on the first half of Season 3 at the time. Other groups we contacted told us the original subtitle files for OAD 02-03 had long been lost, so subtitles for those parts are absent, regrettably.

重发修正：
1. 修复 S1 正片第 12 话的画面问题；
2. 为 S4 的 OST 增补扫图。

2. Add scans for the S4 OST.

item.description:
大小：35.7GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




入间同学入魔了！ / Mairimashita! Iruma-kun / 魔入りました！入間くん S1 BDRip

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

总体来说纹理详实细节丰富动态充盈，线条作画有着儿童涂鸦的粗犷风格，噪点也偏多，这些都显著增加了画面的复杂度，导致编码之后欠码问题随处可见，部分场景劣化严重，好在色带色块并不是特别多。全片多数场景原生分辨率 810，出于画风考虑，我们对逆向拉升重构和降噪均进行了限制，尽量保留粗犷的风格。另外 ED 和 スキ魔 风格强烈，我们只做了简单处理。最终的成品体积较大，你可以理解成日升的良心（上次也是这么说的），是正常现象。
Overall, the texture is well-defined, the image is rich in details and full of lively motion. The lines and sakuga have the rough, doodle-like style of kids' drawings, and there's also quite a lot of grain. All of these made the image much more complex, which led to insufficient bitrate issues all over the place after encoding. Some scenes have gotten a lot worse in quality, but luckily, we don't have too many color banding or blocking issues. Most scenes in the whole video have a native resolution of 810. Because we wanted to preserve the art style, we limited both descaling and reconstruction and denoising, trying our best to keep that rough style. Also, the ED and Sukima have a strong style, so we only did some basic processing on them. The encode has a relatively big file size. You can just think of this as Sunrise's conscience (we said the exact same thing when encoding CROSS ANGE), which is normal.

总监：少儿片是日升良心不可或缺的一部分，虽然不是很多。

The native resolution is 1540x850. The lines are generally decent, and the texture is quite detailed, but the encoding quality is poor. Even with dithering applied to the flat area, there is still some banding in the dark area. The OP suffers from severely insufficient bitrate. Blocking and banding are visible to the naked eye, leaving it basically ruined. We refer to the Crunchyroll source and find almost identical Artifacts, which suggests the video is exported from the master this way. We try our best to restore it, but some scenes remain beyond saving. Please bear with it.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 校园迷糊大王 / School Rumble / スクールランブル 10-bit 720p HEVC DVDRip [S1+S2+OVAs Reseed Fin]
item.description:
大小：32.9GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




校园迷糊大王 / School Rumble / スクールランブル S1+S2+OVAs DVDRip Reseed

School Rumble 全系列的 DVD 原盘都有比较严重的色度平面偏移以及一些常见的 DVD 画面问题。我们针对性地修复了色度平面偏移，并且将画面拉升至 720p；对于少量较为复杂的交错情况（尤其是部分 OP、ED）进行了特殊处理；对于少量严重锯齿和花屏等问题也尽可能地进行了修复。具体的处理包括：
1. 所有动画类视频均使用 Waifu2x-caffe 拉伸至 720p（三学期漫画广播剧特典除外，使用了 NNEDI3 让文字看起来略微自然一点）。片源中的噪点经过采样后抹除，然后在画面拉伸后重新打入，同时适当加黑了线条，使画风更接近片源，减弱基于神经网络的拉伸算法造成的油画感。
2. 由于制作后期剪辑问题，片源的少部分段落交错模式相当复杂，无法使用普通场匹配算法恢复。我们针对不同片段的特点进行了遮罩以及手动场匹配和反交错处理，避免引入额外的画面问题，并尽可能保持画面原本动态的流畅（如第一季 ED）。为了达到尽可能完美的 IVTC 效果，我们在确定基本处理之后将全部内容进行了试压制，全程观看了所有试压制成品，找出自动 IVTC 的错误，并逐一进行了手动修正。
3. 色度平面偏移问题在全部动画类片源中都相当明显。我们将色度平面移回了正确位置来消除这一问题。
4. 一学期补习和二学期片源中的个别镜头出现了非常严重的锯齿。我们下重手进行了抗锯齿操作，力图让锯齿不那么明显。
5. 二学期的 24、25 集片源出现了大量底部 1-2 行像素被切掉变成黑边的现象，这一现象在全系列其他地方也偶尔出现。对于画面底部为静态的镜头，我们用邻近帧的底部对黑边进行了填充；对于动态画面，则使用同一帧内黑边上方的邻近行向下进行了填充。
6. 二学期的 24 集片源出现了几帧花屏损坏。我们将这几帧在 Photoshop 里进行了手动修复，替换掉了损坏的帧。
The whole series of School Rumble has obvious chroma shift in the source, with some common issues found in DVDs as well. We fixed the chroma shift, and upscaled the picture to 720p. Occasional complex interlaced scenes (especially in some openings and endings) were dealt with custom-written IVTC functions. We also tried our best to fix some heavily aliased scenes and corrupted frames in the source. In particular:
1. All animated videos were upscaled to 720p using Waifu2x-caffe, with the only exception of the SP vomic in San Gakki where NNEDI3 were used to make the text appears slightly better. Grains were sampled, removed and reapplied after upscaling, and lines were adaptively darkened, in order to recover some of the visual features of the source and reduce the overall "oil painting effect" introduced by neural network-based scalers.
2. The source has some complex interlaced scenes due to bad editing, which cannot be recovered by normal field-matching algorithms. Customized masking and manual field-matching/deinterlacing were used in some of these cases, to avoid introducing additional artifacts and retain the smooth motion (e.g. the ending of S1) as much as possible. Given the imperfect nature of automatic IVTC, we had a dry run for all the encodings, watched them and tried to catch and fix the errors before the release.
3. Chroma shift is prominent across all animated videos. We tried to move the chroma planes back in place to fix this unpleasant artifact.
4. A few cuts in Ichi Gakki Hoshuu and Ni Gakki are heavily aliased. We tried our best to make them not as obvious.
5. There are lots of frames appear as clipped at the bottom by 1-2 pixels in Ni Gakki ep.24 and ep.25, and occasionally in other places. We tried to fill the gap with lines from adjacent frames (if they're supposed to be same) or lines above the gap from the same frame (if no adjacent frames can be used).
6. There are several corrupted frames in Ni Gakki ep.24. We fixed them in Photoshop and replaced the frames back into the video.

重发修正：
1. 整合 SP9 对第一季 EP15 的修正；
2. 重命名部分特典视频；
3. 打包 SPs/Menu 目录的图片；
4. 增补第一季意版 DVD 扫图；
5. 按照现行规范重新整理 CD；
6. 删除 readme about WebP.txt。

Reseed comment:
1. The fix for S01E15 from Service Pack 9 was included;
2. Renamed some of the video files in SP;
3. Pictures under SPs/Menu were packed into 7z archives;
4. Added S01 Scans from Italian version DVD;
5. Reorganized CD according to current rules;
6. Removed readme about WebP.txt.

整理 / Collate: aya
发布 / Upload: dc
分流 / Seed: VCB-Studio CDN 分流成员

5. 二学期的 24、25 集片源出现了大量底部 1-2 行像素被切掉变成黑边的现象，这一现象在全系列其他地方也偶尔出现。对于画面底部为静态的镜头，我们用邻近帧的底部对黑边进行了填充；对于动态画面，则使用同一帧内黑边上方的邻近行向下进行了填充。
6. 二学期的 24 集片源出现了几帧花屏损坏。我们将这几帧在 Photoshop 里进行了手动修复，替换掉了损坏的帧。
The whole series of School Rumble has obvious chroma shift in the source, with some common issues found in DVDs as well. We fixed the chroma shift, and upscaled the picture to 720p. Occasional complex interlaced scenes (especially in some openings and endings) were dealt with custom-written IVTC functions. We also tried our best to fix some heavily aliased scenes and corrupted frames in the source. In particular:
1. All animated videos were upscaled to 720p using Waifu2x-caffe, with the only exception of the SP vomic in San Gakki where NNEDI3 were used to make the text appears slightly better. Grains were sampled, removed and reapplied after upscaling, and lines were adaptively darkened, in order to recover some of the visual features of the source and reduce the overall "oil painting effect" introduced by neural network-based scalers.
2. The source has some complex interlaced scenes due to bad editing, which cannot be recovered by normal field-matching algorithms. Customized masking and manual field-matching/deinterlacing were used in some of these cases, to avoid introducing additional artifacts and retain the smooth motion (e.g. the ending of S1) as much as possible. Given the imperfect nature of automatic IVTC, we had a dry run for all the encodings, watched them and tried to catch and fix the errors before the release.
3. Chroma shift is prominent across all animated videos. We tried to move the chroma planes back in place to fix this unpleasant artifact.
4. A few cuts in Ichi Gakki Hoshuu and Ni Gakki are heavily aliased. We tried our best to make them not as obvious.
5. There are lots of frames appear as clipped at the bottom by 1-2 pixels in Ni Gakki ep.24 and ep.25, and occasionally in other places. We tried to fill the gap with lines from adjacent frames (if they're supposed to be same) or lines above the gap from the same frame (if no adjacent frames can be used).
6. There are several corrupted frames in Ni Gakki ep.24. We fixed them in Photoshop and replaced the frames back into the video.

2. 重命名部分特典视频；

4. 增补第一季意版 DVD 扫图；

刹那之花 / Momentary Lily / もめんたりー・リリィ BDRip

这个项目与 SweetSub 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with SweetSub. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

《刹那之花》的原盘质量欠佳，画面普遍存在欠码瑕疵，线条也明显带有振晕，特别是在动作场面中，色块失真尤为严重。其根本原因在于，对于 GoHands 认真的作画精度（翻译：24fps 的背景）而言，Blu-ray 媒介所能提供的码率上限实在捉襟见肘，甚至连加入保护性噪点的余量都没有。
The source suffers from poor image quality, characterized by pervasive lack of bitrate, prominent ringing around lines, and particularly severe blocking in motion scenes. The fundamental reason lies in the fact that Blu-ray can only provide an inadequate bitrate compared to the exquisite animation of GoHands (notably the 24fps backgrounds), leaving no overhead for protective grain.

除了欠码问题外，GoHands 的光污染渲染管线一直存在精度问题，少部分光晕效果会伴随着非常可见的色带。
Additionally, GoHands' notorious lighting-heavy rendering pipeline continues to lack precision, resulting in pronounced banding in several halo effects.

受限于源的质量，我们只能采取较为权宜的处理方针，在细节保留和瑕疵修复之间作出一定取舍，尽量兼顾画面完整性与最终观感。
Due to these source limitations, a compromised pre-processing was eventually performed, balancing detail preservation and artifact removal to ensure visual integrity and overall viewing.

item.description:

药屋少女的呢喃 第二季 / Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 2nd Season / 薬屋のひとりごと 2nd Season BDRip

内封原盘 JPN 字幕。
Embedded official JPN PGS.
部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

猫猫第二季的画面风格与第一季类同，原生分辨率同样约为 955p。有趣的是，制作方仿佛看到了我们先前的制作吐槽，第二季的视频码率有了明显改善，也重新加入了保护性噪点。遗憾的是，除了常规的亮度平面噪点外，制作方又矫枉过正地在色度平面上也加入了细腻的高频动噪，结果不仅重蹈了第一季整体欠码的覆辙，色块问题在对比之下反而有所恶化，对此我们深感无奈。
相较于第一季的瑕疵修复方针，本次我们增加了欠码修复与色平面修复的步骤，以适配这些新出现的瑕疵。
The art style of Maomao 2nd Season is similar to that of the 1st Season, with the native resolution also remaining at around 955p. Interestingly, as if the production team notices our previous complaints, the video bitrate for the 2nd Season improves significantly, and protective grain is re-added. Unfortunately, apart from the regular grain on the luma plane, the production team overcorrects by introducing fine, high-frequency dynamic noise to the chroma planes as well. As a result, this not only repeats the 1st Season's mistake of an overall insufficient bitrate, but also worsens the blocking issues by comparison, leaving us feeling quite helpless.
Compared to our artifact processing approach in the 1st Season, we add extra steps this time to fix the insufficient bitrate and repair the chroma planes to handle these newly emerged artifacts.

For this reason, we only applied simple anti-aliasing, denoising, regraining, and de-banding.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 涅库罗诺美子的宇宙恐怖秀 / Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show / ネクロノミ子のコズミックホラーショウ 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：20.3GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




涅库罗诺美子的宇宙恐怖秀 / Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show / ネクロノミ子のコズミックホラーショウ BDRip

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Some episodes contain commentary tracks.

作为年度烂片，制作还算可以，正片原生分辨率 900，制作流程看起来十分稳定，总体并没有引入什么瑕疵。就是片子里的克系要素实在太多，各类五彩斑斓的画面层出不穷，噪点强度也过高，平面上众多弱线条弱纹理和噪点混在一起，经过编码的原盘有明显涂抹，同时还引入了不少色块色带蚊噪，高动态和暗场尤甚。为了保留这些所剩不多的细节，我们对噪点层做了单独提取和处理，尽量保证观感，同时消除欠码，最后选用针对性较强的参数进行了编码。除此之外，OPED 含有高强度噪点和克系特效，导致了严重的 dct pattern，难以直视，这部分只能尽力而为了。另外第一集末尾的 OP 制作人员报幕相比 Web 源有极为异常的 UV 锐化瑕疵，我们替换成了 CR 源的版本。
For a series called one of the worst of the year, its production is not too terrible. The main feature has a native resolution of 900. Its production workflow looks very stable, and it does not introduce extra artifacts overall. The only problem is that the image has far too many Cthulhu-inspired elements. It is filled with wildly colorful scenes, and the noise intensity is way too heavy. Many faint lines and weak textures in the flat areas blend in with the noise. After encoding, the BD source shows obvious noise degradation. The image also picks up blocking, color banding, and DCT noise. These issues are especially bad in high-dynamic scenes and dark areas. To keep the little remaining detail, we extracted and processed the noise layer separately. We worked to keep the viewing experience clean, while fixing the issues due to insufficient bitrate. Finally, we chose strongly targeted parameters for encoding. On top of that, the OP and ED have high-intensity noise and Cthulhu-inspired VFXs. This causes severe DCT pattern that has a bad look. There's only so much we can do to fix this part. Also, the staff credits at the end of Episode 1 have very abnormal UV sharpening artifacts next to the WEB-DL source. We replaced this part with the version from the CR source.

总监：剧情和画面的双重冲击亦是一种不可名状的克苏鲁

item.description:
大小：23.1GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




夜晚的水母不会游泳 / Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai / 夜のクラゲは泳げない BDRip

这个项目与 喵萌奶茶屋 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in collaboration with Nekomoe kissaten. Thanks to them for crafting Chinese subtitles.

原盘画质中等偏上。线条精细，但所有线条都带有又细又亮的振铃现象，偶尔出现较为明显的锯齿，影响观感。平面质量受到 5G 一集体积的拖累，虽然暗部细节丰富，但存在不少可见的欠码小瑕疵，部分渐暗场景则会出现大面积色块。我们对线条进行了适当强度的去振铃和较弱的抗锯齿处理，并辅以补偿性锐化来提升观感；对平面则仅进行了自适应降噪和保守的去色带处理，以保留更多暗部细节。
The quality of Yorukura's Blu-ray is above average. The lines are fine, but all lines have thin, bright ringing, and aliasing becomes apparent from time to time, which can be distracting. The quality of flat areas is held back by the 5GB file size. Even though dark areas have rich detail, there are many visible minor artifacts from insufficient bitrate, and in some dark scenes large areas of blocking appear. We applied moderate de-ringing and mild anti-aliasing to the lines, then added compensatory sharpening to improve the viewing experience; for flat areas, we only used adaptive denoising and mild de-banding to preserve more detail in dark areas.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 全金属狂潮 / Full Metal Panic! 10-bit 720p/1080p AVC/HEVC BDRip [S1-S4 Reseed Fin]
item.description:
大小：79.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




S1: 全金属狂潮 / Full Metal Panic! BDRip Reseed

S2: 全金属狂潮 校园篇 / Full Metal Panic? Fumoffu BDRip Reseed

S3: 全金属狂潮 The Second Raid / Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid BDRip Reseed

S4: 全金属狂潮 Invisible Victory / Full Metal Panic! Invisible Victory BDRip Reseed

前三季内封原盘 ENG 字幕。
Seasons 1–3 include embedded English PGS subtitles.
前三季外挂英配 FLAC 5.1。第四季外挂日语 FLAC 5.1 + AAC 评论音轨 + DTS Headphone:X.
Seasons 1–3 include external MKA files containing the English FLAC 5.1 dub. Season 4 includes external tracks featuring Japanese FLAC 5.1 audio, an AAC commentary track, and DTS Headphone:X.

S1-S3:
全金的蓝光表明了就是 DVD 拉上来加黑边到 1080p 的。日版和美版蓝光画质都很感人。相对 24p 的美版蓝光来说，24t 的日版蓝光烂得更彻底点，所以这个版本采用美版蓝光制作。画质处理上主要是强力处理劣质 upscale 的后遗症，包括 inverse-upscale 到 720p，然后配合 aa 和 dering。
The two BD sources of Full metal panic, the JP ver. and the US ver., are both up-scaled from DVD, and after comparison, we conclude the US ver is slightly better than the JP ver., so we use the US ver. BD for this BDRip. To counter the artifacts caused by the up-scale, we use inverse-bicubic (sharp) to reverse the BD to 720p, and then perform de-ringing, anti-aliasing and de-banding.

S4:
原盘画质总体较好，线条锐利纹理清晰，但部分锐利线条边缘存在轻微锯齿和晕轮；平面暗处区域有轻微色带和噪点。针对这种情况，在预处理上针对性的对线条做了低强度的反锯齿和去晕轮，在平面区域做了去色带、自适应降噪及低频增强。最后使用中高码率 x265 参数进行压制。
The overall quality of the source is decent, with sharp lines and clear textures, but slight aliasing and haloing effects can be found near some sharp edges, and mild banding and noise in dark flat areas. To deal with these artifacts, we applied weak anti-aliasing and dehaloing to lines, and debanding, adaptive denoise and enhancement of low-frequency textures to the flat areas. Lastly, we encoded with relatively high bit-rate with x265.

重发修正：
S1-S3
1. 合并 SP9 对 S3 真人特典的修正；
2. 调整部分视频命名；
3. 修正部分视频的元数据问题；
4. 按现行规范调整部分视频轨道的语言标签、默认值；
5. 修正 PGS 字幕的存放位置；
6. 删除 S3 特典 PILOT FILM 中的无效 PGS 字幕；
7. 补充 S3 正片缺失的起始章节；
8. 调整章节标题；
9. 新增收录 S2 和 S3 OVA 的特典 CD；
10. 按现行规范重新整理 CD。
S4
1. 修正外挂音轨的默认值为否；
2. 删除部分特典视频中的空章节；
3. 调整部分特典视频的命名；
4. 新增收录美版扫图及增刊号；
5. 新增收录部分 CD 规格的专辑；
6. 按现行规范重新整理 CD。

Reseed comment:
S1-S3
1. Merged fixes from SP9 for the live-action in S3;
2. Renamed some videos;
3. Fixed metadata issues in some videos;
4. Adjusted language tags and default values of some tracks according to current standards;
5. Fixed the placement of PGS subtitles;
6. Removed invalid PGS subtitles from the S3 bonus PILOT FILM;
7. Added missing opening chapters to S3 main episodes;
8. Adjusted chapter titles;
9. Added bonus CDs containing the S2 and S3 OVA;
10. Reorganized CDs according to current standards.
S4
1. Set the default flag of external audio tracks to No;
2. Removed empty chapters in some bonus videos;
3. Renamed some bonus videos;
4. Added scans from the US release and the special issue;
5. Newly included some CD-format albums;
6. Reorganized CDs according to current standards.

粗糙的画风充分“揭示”了社畜的艰辛。这样的线条也没什么处理的必要，仅做了极轻的抗锯齿和常规抗振铃。平面质量也还行，11 集末尾有一处重噪欠码我们进行了修复，其余部分均只做了保底处理。

item.description:

继母的拖油瓶是我的前女友 BDRip
Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta BDRip
継母の連れ子が元カノだった BDRip

原生分辨率在 720 上下有较大波动，考虑到 p9 的制作水平并不意外。线条有比较强的锯齿和振铃，OPED 有一定量锐化。平面噪点还算完好，也没什么色带。部分场景遭受了编码 VBV 限制有较强的劣化。由于以上种种原因，考虑到逆向拉升重构误差波动，我们融合了多种常规/神经网络处理手段，消除瑕疵的同时尽量避免副作用。
The native resolution fluctuates significantly around 720, which is not surprising given project No.9's production level. The lines exhibit severe aliasing and ringing, and the OP/ED have a moderate amount of sharpening. The noise in flat areas is relatively intact, and there's little to no banding. Some scenes suffered from significant degradation due to VBV limitations during encoding. Considering the fluctuations in rescaling errors for the reasons above, we integrated a variety of routine and neural network-based processing methods to eliminate artifacts while minimizing side effects.

另外由于原盘特典极度匮乏，我们还收录制作了官方在 YouTube 上放出的广播剧，不过画质实在太差就凑合看吧。欢迎有志之士制作字幕。
Additionally, because the bonus contents are too few, we have also encoded the official voice drama released on YouTube. However, the image quality is quite poor, so please bear with it. We welcome interested groups to create subtitles for it.

继母的拖油瓶是我的前女友 BDRip

Some scenes suffered from significant degradation due to VBV limitations during encoding. Considering the fluctuations in rescaling errors for the reasons above, we integrated a variety of routine and neural network-based processing methods to eliminate artifacts while minimizing side effects.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 丹特丽安的书架 / Dantalian no Shoka / ダンタリアンの書架 10-bit 1080p AV1 BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：10.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




丹特丽安的书架 / Dantalian no Shoka / ダンタリアンの書架 BDRip

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

整体画质极差，简单来说，出现了 BD 及 DVD 原盘可能出现的几乎所有问题。更为棘手的是，许多瑕疵并非持续存在，而是间歇性出现，这进一步增加了处理的难度与复杂度。
The overall image quality is very poor. Basically, it has almost every artifact you could find in BD and DVD sources. The situation is especially tricky because many artifacts come and go. This makes the cleanup much harder and more complex.

原盘（含特典）主要瑕疵汇总如下：强色带、二值化锯齿、缩放锯齿、振铃、色块、烂边、蚊噪、亮度越界、多种交错类型、色度色带、色度锯齿及色度偏移。此外，如何在保留噪点观感与控制体积之间寻求平衡，也是处理难点之一。
The main artifacts in the source (including bonus videos) are: strong banding, binarized aliasing, scaling aliasing, ringing, blocking, dirty edges, DCT noise, luma overflow, several types of interlacing, chroma banding, chroma aliasing, and chroma shift. Another challenge was balancing the need to keep the grain-looking natural while keeping the bit-rate reasonable.

下面详述几个突出问题：
Below are detailed discussions of several prominent issues:

首先是色带：尽管画面整体覆盖高强度噪点，但色带问题依然严峻。原因大概率是色带在加入噪点层及编码之前，即制作流程的相对早期环节已被引入。特征为色带排列整齐，主要表现为平行的直线或曲线，部分色带在 8bit 下跨度为 2 。这种整齐明显的色带与其上覆盖的高强度噪点，给修复带来了很大的困难。此外，本片的一些背景使用了色调分离（Posterization）特效（此类“色带”为艺术效果，需尽力保留），若为去除真正的强色带而采用高强度的处理手段，会严重破坏背景细节。因此，常规去色带手段在此并不适用。经过实验，我们最终采用了一种非常规方案：组合基于神经网络的降噪模型与传统去色带方法对色带进行处理，尽可能地在最大程度去除色带的同时，保留背景风格及细节。
First is banding. Even though the whole image is covered in heavy noise, the banding is still very bad. It was probably introduced early in production, before the noise layer and before encoding. Most visible banding lines up neatly like straight or curved parallel lines, in some of which, the color value change between adjacent bands is around 2 in 8-bit, very noticeable. This clear banding under heavy noise is very difficult to fix. Also, some backgrounds use a posterization effect on purpose. This “banding” is an artistic choice and we tried hard to keep it. If strong processing methods are used to remove the actual heavy banding, background details would be severely damaged. Therefore, routine de-banding methods are not suitable here. After testing, we used a special method. We combined a neural network denoising model with standard de-banding. The goal was to remove the bad banding without harming the background's art style and details.

其次是色度平面，分两种情况处理：1-5 卷整体质量尚可，仅存在一些欠码瑕疵，我们采用了常规色度重构进行修复。第 6 卷问题较为严重，不仅存在色度偏移，色度平面也有极严重的锯齿及欠码瑕疵。对此，我们先修复了色度偏移，接下来使用两轮不同算法的色度重构，最终将色度平面修复至可接受的观感水平。
Next, the chroma planes. We treated it in two parts. For Volumes 1-5, the quality was okay, with only minor issues from lack of bitrate. We fixed these with standard chroma reconstruction. Volume 6 was much worse. It had chroma shift, very bad chroma aliasing, and other problems from lack of bitrate. We fixed the chroma shift first. Then, we did two rounds of chroma reconstruction with different methods. This brought the color quality back to a watchable level.

最后关于噪点：官方制作组似乎在有意调整不同集数的噪点强度，典型如第 6 集（不同主角的单元剧）与第 9 集（书中世界），这两集的噪点层性质与其他集数相当不同。此外，其余集数间噪点强度也有变化，比如前 2 集的噪点层非常强，而后面的集数（尤其是第 6 集以后）的噪点层相对弱一些。另外 ED 部分为真人实拍，噪点特性又有所不同。对此，我们进行了逐集测试，并在必要时使用了差异化的降噪参数，同时对 ED 作了独立处理。此外，考虑到前述色带问题及处理方案，我们不得不舍弃大部分原片噪点层，转而通过实时分析进行自适应噪点重构，并对噪点层进行了适度削弱及自适应降噪处理以控制体积。
Finally, about the noise. The official production seems to have changed the noise intensity between episodes. Episode 6 (side story episode with alternative protagonist) and Episode 9 (the "book world") have noise that is quite different from the rest. The noise is also stronger in the first 2 episodes and gets weaker after Episode 6. The live-action ED has its own type of noise. We tested each episode separately and used different denoising settings when needed. The ED was processed on its own. Also, because of how we dealt with the banding problem, we had to remove most of the original noise. We then rebuilt a new, adaptive noise layer in real-time. We also reduced the noise a bit and used adaptive denoising to help control the bit-rate.

除了上述几点外，其他的瑕疵都用了常规方法来处理，不再赘述。
Other issues were fixed using standard methods, so we won't go into detail here.

OVA 是 DVD 载体，画质一般，我们将其拉伸到 720p 同时转换到相应色域。主要进行了去色带和去振铃处理，原盘噪点质量不佳，我们将其丢弃，然后额外构建了与片源风格类似的噪点层以保持观感。
The OVA is under a DVD source with average quality. We upscaled it to 720p and converted the color space. We mainly did de-banding and de-ringing. The original noise was poor, so we removed it and added a new noise layer that matches the style of the source to keep the right look.

本次我们制作了两个版本的成品，除了常规的 HEVC 版，还有一个实验性的小体积 AV1 版。由于本片的高强度噪点问题，HEVC 版在压缩上用了比较激进的方案来尽可能减小成品体积，另外为了更好地保留色度重构的成果，本次使用了 YUV444 格式进行编码。AV1 版由于编码器限制仍然使用了 YUV420 格式，特典方面进行了极大简化，只保留了几种主要的特典视频。
We made two versions this time: a standard HEVC version and an experimental, smaller AV1 version. Because of the heavy noise, the HEVC version uses aggressive encoding settings to keep the size down. To better preserve the results of our chroma reconstruction, we encoded it in YUV444 format. The AV1 version still uses YUV420 due to encoder limits. The bonus videos are much less than HEVC version, keeping only a few main ones.

本次 AV1 成品使用 SVT-AV1-PSY 编码器进行编码，该版本添加了 PSY 视觉心理学优化（这也是 x26x 系列编码器重要的功能），在纹理和线条方面都有极大的提升，这也是我们决定发布 AV1 版的主要原因。虽然比起 x265 仍然还有一些差距，但对于本片这种内容较糊+强噪点的特殊情况，可以做到观感接近的情况下，节省超过一半的体积，具有非常高的性价比。
The AV1 version was encoded with the SVT-AV1-PSY encoder. This version has PSY optimization (a key feature in x26x encoders), which greatly improves texture and line quality. This is the main reason we made an AV1 version. While it's still not quite as good as x265, for this specific case of blurry content with heavy noise, it looks nearly as good while saving more than half the bit-rate. It's very efficient.

得益于 AV1 的 Film Grain Synthesis 功能，可以以极少的码率产生高强度的噪点，节省很多体积。AV1 成品整体噪点风格和强度与 HEVC 版相比几乎没有差异，不过由于部分噪点是通过 Film Grain Synthesis 功能合成的，在少数色彩复杂的场景下可能质量较低。在画质方面，由于本片内容较糊，还覆盖有很强的噪点，AV1 对细节保留的缺陷被很好地掩盖。如果暂停放大来看，线条和纹理表现可能还是稍差一点，不过实际播放场景基本难以感知。
Thanks to AV1's Film Grain Synthesis feature, it can create heavy noise with very low bitrate, saving a lot of size. The overall noise style and strength are almost the same as the HEVC version. However, since some noise is synthetic, it might look worse in a few very colorful scenes. For general picture quality, the blurry content and heavy noise hide AV1's weakness in keeping fine details. If you pause and zoom in, lines and textures might look a bit worse, but you're unlikely to notice during normal playback.

总监：这部加上GOSICK和蔷薇少女，总算是把我喜欢的几部哥特萝莉作品都补完了，开坑的时候完全没想到居然最后花了两年多才做完（感叹）。在此感谢所有参与这个项目以及提供帮助的人。
整理：妲丽安可爱捏

整理 / Collate: maboroshi
发布 / Upload: Анастасия

Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

整体画质极差，简单来说，出现了 BD 及 DVD 原盘可能出现的几乎所有问题。更为棘手的是，许多瑕疵并非持续存在，而是间歇性出现，这进一步增加了处理的难度与复杂度。
The overall image quality is very poor. Basically, it has almost every artifact you could find in BD and DVD sources. The situation is especially tricky because many artifacts come and go. This makes the cleanup much harder and more complex.

原盘（含特典）主要瑕疵汇总如下：强色带、二值化锯齿、缩放锯齿、振铃、色块、烂边、蚊噪、亮度越界、多种交错类型、色度色带、色度锯齿及色度偏移。此外，如何在保留噪点观感与控制体积之间寻求平衡，也是处理难点之一。
The main artifacts in the source (including bonus videos) are: strong banding, binarized aliasing, scaling aliasing, ringing, blocking, dirty edges, DCT noise, luma overflow, several types of interlacing, chroma banding, chroma aliasing, and chroma shift. Another challenge was balancing the need to keep the grain-looking natural while keeping the bit-rate reasonable.

下面详述几个突出问题：
Below are detailed discussions of several prominent issues:

首先是色带：尽管画面整体覆盖高强度噪点，但色带问题依然严峻。原因大概率是色带在加入噪点层及编码之前，即制作流程的相对早期环节已被引入。特征为色带排列整齐，主要表现为平行的直线或曲线，部分色带在 8bit 下跨度为 2 。这种整齐明显的色带与其上覆盖的高强度噪点，给修复带来了很大的困难。此外，本片的一些背景使用了色调分离（Posterization）特效（此类“色带”为艺术效果，需尽力保留），若为去除真正的强色带而采用高强度的处理手段，会严重破坏背景细节。因此，常规去色带手段在此并不适用。经过实验，我们最终采用了一种非常规方案：组合基于神经网络的降噪模型与传统去色带方法对色带进行处理，尽可能地在最大程度去除色带的同时，保留背景风格及细节。
First is banding. Even though the whole image is covered in heavy noise, the banding is still very bad. It was probably introduced early in production, before the noise layer and before encoding. Most visible banding lines up neatly like straight or curved parallel lines, in some of which, the color value change between adjacent bands is around 2 in 8-bit, very noticeable. This clear banding under heavy noise is very difficult to fix. Also, some backgrounds use a posterization effect on purpose. This “banding” is an artistic choice and we tried hard to keep it. If strong processing methods are used to remove the actual heavy banding, background details would be severely damaged. Therefore, routine de-banding methods are not suitable here. After testing, we used a special method. We combined a neural network denoising model with standard de-banding. The goal was to remove the bad banding without harming the background's art style and details.

其次是色度平面，分两种情况处理：1-5 卷整体质量尚可，仅存在一些欠码瑕疵，我们采用了常规色度重构进行修复。第 6 卷问题较为严重，不仅存在色度偏移，色度平面也有极严重的锯齿及欠码瑕疵。对此，我们先修复了色度偏移，接下来使用两轮不同算法的色度重构，最终将色度平面修复至可接受的观感水平。
Next, the chroma planes. We treated it in two parts. For Volumes 1-5, the quality was okay, with only minor issues from lack of bitrate. We fixed these with standard chroma reconstruction. Volume 6 was much worse. It had chroma shift, very bad chroma aliasing, and other problems from lack of bitrate. We fixed the chroma shift first. Then, we did two rounds of chroma reconstruction with different methods. This brought the color quality back to a watchable level.

最后关于噪点：官方制作组似乎在有意调整不同集数的噪点强度，典型如第 6 集（不同主角的单元剧）与第 9 集（书中世界），这两集的噪点层性质与其他集数相当不同。此外，其余集数间噪点强度也有变化，比如前 2 集的噪点层非常强，而后面的集数（尤其是第 6 集以后）的噪点层相对弱一些。另外 ED 部分为真人实拍，噪点特性又有所不同。对此，我们进行了逐集测试，并在必要时使用了差异化的降噪参数，同时对 ED 作了独立处理。此外，考虑到前述色带问题及处理方案，我们不得不舍弃大部分原片噪点层，转而通过实时分析进行自适应噪点重构，并对噪点层进行了适度削弱及自适应降噪处理以控制体积。
Finally, about the noise. The official production seems to have changed the noise intensity between episodes. Episode 6 (side story episode with alternative protagonist) and Episode 9 (the "book world") have noise that is quite different from the rest. The noise is also stronger in the first 2 episodes and gets weaker after Episode 6. The live-action ED has its own type of noise. We tested each episode separately and used different denoising settings when needed. The ED was processed on its own. Also, because of how we dealt with the banding problem, we had to remove most of the original noise. We then rebuilt a new, adaptive noise layer in real-time. We also reduced the noise a bit and used adaptive denoising to help control the bit-rate.

除了上述几点外，其他的瑕疵都用了常规方法来处理，不再赘述。
Other issues were fixed using standard methods, so we won't go into detail here.

OVA 是 DVD 载体，画质一般，我们将其拉伸到 720p 同时转换到相应色域。主要进行了去色带和去振铃处理，原盘噪点质量不佳，我们将其丢弃，然后额外构建了与片源风格类似的噪点层以保持观感。
The OVA is under a DVD source with average quality. We upscaled it to 720p and converted the color space. We mainly did de-banding and de-ringing. The original noise was poor, so we removed it and added a new noise layer that matches the style of the source to keep the right look.

本次我们制作了两个版本的成品，除了常规的 HEVC 版，还有一个实验性的小体积 AV1 版。由于本片的高强度噪点问题，HEVC 版在压缩上用了比较激进的方案来尽可能减小成品体积，另外为了更好地保留色度重构的成果，本次使用了 YUV444 格式进行编码。AV1 版由于编码器限制仍然使用了 YUV420 格式，特典方面进行了极大简化，只保留了几种主要的特典视频。
We made two versions this time: a standard HEVC version and an experimental, smaller AV1 version. Because of the heavy noise, the HEVC version uses aggressive encoding settings to keep the size down. To better preserve the results of our chroma reconstruction, we encoded it in YUV444 format. The AV1 version still uses YUV420 due to encoder limits. The bonus videos are much less than HEVC version, keeping only a few main ones.

本次 AV1 成品使用 SVT-AV1-PSY 编码器进行编码，该版本添加了 PSY 视觉心理学优化（这也是 x26x 系列编码器重要的功能），在纹理和线条方面都有极大的提升，这也是我们决定发布 AV1 版的主要原因。虽然比起 x265 仍然还有一些差距，但对于本片这种内容较糊+强噪点的特殊情况，可以做到观感接近的情况下，节省超过一半的体积，具有非常高的性价比。
The AV1 version was encoded with the SVT-AV1-PSY encoder. This version has PSY optimization (a key feature in x26x encoders), which greatly improves texture and line quality. This is the main reason we made an AV1 version. While it's still not quite as good as x265, for this specific case of blurry content with heavy noise, it looks nearly as good while saving more than half the bit-rate. It's very efficient.

得益于 AV1 的 Film Grain Synthesis 功能，可以以极少的码率产生高强度的噪点，节省很多体积。AV1 成品整体噪点风格和强度与 HEVC 版相比几乎没有差异，不过由于部分噪点是通过 Film Grain Synthesis 功能合成的，在少数色彩复杂的场景下可能质量较低。在画质方面，由于本片内容较糊，还覆盖有很强的噪点，AV1 对细节保留的缺陷被很好地掩盖。如果暂停放大来看，线条和纹理表现可能还是稍差一点，不过实际播放场景基本难以感知。
Thanks to AV1's Film Grain Synthesis feature, it can create heavy noise with very low bitrate, saving a lot of size. The overall noise style and strength are almost the same as the HEVC version. However, since some noise is synthetic, it might look worse in a few very colorful scenes. For general picture quality, the blurry content and heavy noise hide AV1's weakness in keeping fine details. If you pause and zoom in, lines and textures might look a bit worse, but you're unlikely to notice during normal playback.

总监：这部加上GOSICK和蔷薇少女，总算是把我喜欢的几部哥特萝莉作品都补完了，开坑的时候完全没想到居然最后花了两年多才做完（感叹）。在此感谢所有参与这个项目以及提供帮助的人。
整理：妲丽安可爱捏

item.description:
大小：22.2GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




Another BDRip

本番由 组员提名，应要求制作。感谢他们为 VCB-Studio 发展做出的无私奉献。
This project was nominated by our members and produced upon request. Thanks to them for their selfless dedication to the development of VCB-Studio.

原盘画质较为糟糕，色度平面的问题非常严重。全片色度平面有较明显的色度偏移，此外色度线条还有严重的锯齿问题。我们先测定并修复色度偏移，然后使用神经网络算法重构色度平面。原盘原生分辨率在 719.8p 附近，亮度平面的线条有低质量拉升造成的锯齿和模糊，此外还有很多 3D 建模锯齿，我们使用逆向拉升重构和常规手段去除。平面质量还行，不过由于原盘码率偏低和当年编码质量有限，一些高动态镜头仍然存在烂噪和色块问题。我们进行了自适应去色块、适度的抗色带和降噪处理。
The source exhibits poor image quality, characterized by a serious issue with chroma plane, including pronounced chroma shift and severe aliasing along chroma lines. The chroma shift was initially measured and fixed, followed by a reconstruction of the chroma plane using a neural network algorithm. The native resolution is approximately 719.8p. Lines from the luma plane also suffer from aliasing and blur resulting from inadequate upscaling, as well as aliasing induced by 3D modeling, which were removed by descaling and reconstruction, and conventional pre-processing. The flat area generally maintains acceptable quality, despite DCT noise and blocking in the hyperdynamic scene, attributable to the deficient bitrate and limited encoding quality at that time. Adaptive de-blocking, proper de-banding, and denoising were performed to address the issues above.

item.description:

偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩 / THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS / アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ BDRip Rev

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

本次重制我们使用 BDBOX 进行制作，增补了 BDBOX 独占的特典，同时也提高了画质定位。本次重制也对周边资源进行了重新收集和整理，由于 CD 数量众多，我们按照官方划分的系列来整理 CD。对于动画系列全部收集，其余衍生作品则选取了几个代表性的系列进行收集，同时本次也增补了大量 Hi-Res 版专辑。
This rework was produced using BDBOX, with a supplement of SPs exclusive to BDBOX and an enhancement in image quality target. The scans and CDs were reorganized and re-collected for this release, and the CDs were categorized by the official series classification due to extensive volume. The collection encompassed the complete animation series alongside representative derivative works, with a substantial addition of Hi-Res albums.

偶像大师灰姑娘女孩的原盘画质在今日看来属于中等偏上水平。第一季的原生分辨率为 810p，第二季的原生分辨率则变为 809.8p 左右，并且拉升算法完全不同。具体表现在画面上，可以观察到第一季的线条有轻微锯齿但没有什么晕轮，第二季的线条锐度稍高一些，并且伴有更明显的锯齿和晕轮。根据我们更细致的检测，实际上从第一季最后几集就已经开始穿插一些与第二季原生分辨率相同的片段。针对以上问题，我们采用自适应逆向拉伸重构，配合常规抗锯齿和去晕轮来进行处理。原盘平面质量还算可以，基本只在部分场景的噪点层下面存在一些色带问题，我们使用常规手段去除。原盘噪点质量中等，第二季的动噪质量稍差一些。我们对烂掉的动噪进行了清理，并使用亮度自适应降噪来控制码率。
The source possesses an image quality that is still considered above average by current standards, with discrepancies in native resolution of 810p in S1 and approximately 809.8p in S2, as well as distinct upscaling algorithms. Visually, the lines of S1 are surrounded by mild aliasing but minimal haloing, whereas S2 features higher sharpness accompanied by prominent aliasing and haloing. Detailed detection revealed that several segments in the final episodes of S1 actually utilize the identical native resolution as S2. To address the issues above, adaptive descaling and reconstruction were applied, complemented by conventional anti-aliasing and de-haloing. The flat area exhibits acceptable quality, with only some banding beneath the noise layer in specific scenes, which was removed by routine de-banding. The noise quality is mediocre, while the dynamic noise in S2 is inferior. An elimination of the damaged dynamic noise was therefore performed, and luma-adaptive denoising was employed to control the bitrate.

压制 / Encode: 岛村卯月

偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩 / THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS / アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ BDRip Rev

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Certain episodes contain commentary tracks.

本次重制我们使用 BDBOX 进行制作，增补了 BDBOX 独占的特典，同时也提高了画质定位。本次重制也对周边资源进行了重新收集和整理，由于 CD 数量众多，我们按照官方划分的系列来整理 CD。对于动画系列全部收集，其余衍生作品则选取了几个代表性的系列进行收集，同时本次也增补了大量 Hi-Res 版专辑。
This rework was produced using BDBOX, with a supplement of SPs exclusive to BDBOX and an enhancement in image quality target. The scans and CDs were reorganized and re-collected for this release, and the CDs were categorized by the official series classification due to extensive volume. The collection encompassed the complete animation series alongside representative derivative works, with a substantial addition of Hi-Res albums.

偶像大师灰姑娘女孩的原盘画质在今日看来属于中等偏上水平。第一季的原生分辨率为 810p，第二季的原生分辨率则变为 809.8p 左右，并且拉升算法完全不同。具体表现在画面上，可以观察到第一季的线条有轻微锯齿但没有什么晕轮，第二季的线条锐度稍高一些，并且伴有更明显的锯齿和晕轮。根据我们更细致的检测，实际上从第一季最后几集就已经开始穿插一些与第二季原生分辨率相同的片段。针对以上问题，我们采用自适应逆向拉伸重构，配合常规抗锯齿和去晕轮来进行处理。原盘平面质量还算可以，基本只在部分场景的噪点层下面存在一些色带问题，我们使用常规手段去除。原盘噪点质量中等，第二季的动噪质量稍差一些。我们对烂掉的动噪进行了清理，并使用亮度自适应降噪来控制码率。
The source possesses an image quality that is still considered above average by current standards, with discrepancies in native resolution of 810p in S1 and approximately 809.8p in S2, as well as distinct upscaling algorithms. Visually, the lines of S1 are surrounded by mild aliasing but minimal haloing, whereas S2 features higher sharpness accompanied by prominent aliasing and haloing. Detailed detection revealed that several segments in the final episodes of S1 actually utilize the identical native resolution as S2. To address the issues above, adaptive descaling and reconstruction were applied, complemented by conventional anti-aliasing and de-haloing. The flat area exhibits acceptable quality, with only some banding beneath the noise layer in specific scenes, which was removed by routine de-banding. The noise quality is mediocre, while the dynamic noise in S2 is inferior. An elimination of the damaged dynamic noise was therefore performed, and luma-adaptive denoising was employed to control the bitrate.

item.description:
大小：17.3GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




中年男的异世界网购生活 / Around 40 Otoko no Isekai Tsuuhan / アラフォー男の異世界通販 BDRip

本片自带与其里番式剧情相符的简单构图和廉价色指定，还搭配了贫穷厕纸特有的抽象作画，但同时又有丰富的纹理、粗黑平滑的线条，加上原盘还算不错的编码，一时间不知道如何评价画质。除了兴趣使然的恶趣味，我们很难想象还有什么理由能在如此水平下制作这样一个兼具里番和厕纸特色的动画。但不管如何这为我们处理本片提供了不少便利，我们仅做了简单的抗锯齿和补偿性锐化，最后削去一部分噪点以控制体积。
This anime presents simple compositions and a cheap color scheme that fits its hentai-style plot. Its sakuga is also abstract, which is typical for low-budget adaptations. However, it simultaneously features rich textures and thick, smooth lines. The source also has fairly decent encoding. These contradictory traits make its visual quality difficult to categorize. Beyond a twisted sense of humor driven by personal interest, it's hard to imagine why an anime combining hentai and low-budget traits at such a level would be made. Regardless, these very characteristics proved convenient for our processing. We only applied some anti-aliasing and compensatory sharpening. Finally, we applied denoising to control the bit-rate.

item.description:
大小：9.2GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




精灵小姐瘦不了 / Elf-san wa Yaserarenai. / エルフさんは痩せられない。 BDRip

只包含 Mecha Potepote Ver. (无修)，不含 TV Ver.
Only the Mecha Potepote Ver. (uncensored), not the TV Ver.

全片原生分辨率约 837。虽然原盘码率偏低，编码质量倒还可以，瑕疵主要来自动画制作时使用的劣质拉升算法和色度半采样精度不足，导致线条有非常强烈的锯齿、振铃和各种色度问题。亮度平面的线条瑕疵通过常规手段即可解决，但色度平面的线条锐度极高，随意处理会引入各种偏色，反而得不偿失，权衡之后还是只做了简单处理，削弱色度问题，确保目视效果。
The native resolution is about 837. The source has a low bitrate, but the encoding quality is acceptable. The main artifacts come from the poor upscaling algorithm and insufficient chroma subsampling accuracy used during production. This caused significant aliasing, ringing, and various chroma issues in the lines. Problems in the luma plane can be fixed with common methods. However, the lines in the chroma planes are very sharp. Applying strong processing here would risk introducing color shifts, which isn't worthwhile. After consideration, we only did mild processing to lessen the chroma problems and ensure the visual quality remains good.

item.description:

发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




机动战舰抚子号 / Martian Successor NADESICO / 機動戦艦ナデシコ BDRip
机动战舰抚子号 黑暗王子 / Martian Successor NADESICO -The prince of darkness- / 機動戦艦ナデシコ -The prince of darkness- BDRip
激钢人3 热血大决战！！ / Gekiganger III Hot-Blooded Great Battle!! / ゲキ・ガンガー3 熱血大決戦!! BDRip

除 OVA 外其余剧集均为 5.1ch 主音轨。
Except for the OVA, all other episodes are with 5.1ch audio.

本番由 组员提名，应要求制作。感谢他们为 VCB-Studio 发展做出的无私奉献。
This project was nominated by our members and produced upon request. Thanks to them for their selfless dedication to the development of VCB-Studio.

基于 BDBOX 制作。BDBOX 中的片源主要分成四部分：
1. 赛璐珞胶片重扫的 TV 正片
2. 重扫后额外降噪的剧场版
3. 使用原始素材的激钢人主题 OVA
4. 其他特典

TV 全片带有目视可见的强烈动噪，相当原汁原味。动噪作为赛璐珞的“精髓"，我们处理噪点层时尽可能进行了留存。又考虑到 x265 的性质并不适合如此强烈的风格，我们使用了对噪点更友好的 x264 进行编码。除此以外，全片各处均有程度不一的交错残留和断线，我们一并进行了修复。
剧场版黑暗王子由于进行了额外降噪，目视效果上相比 TV 要好得多。但仔细看动噪依旧多到发指，处理基本就沿用 TV，在此基础上还修复了画面边缘很多圈的烂边。
激钢人主题 OVA 用的是上古原始素材，自然是古神级画质，彩虹、点状斑纹、烂边、强烈晃动、交错劣化无一不缺，事已至此只好勉强处理了，最后盖上动噪以保证观感。
至于其他特典也各有各的问题，考虑到他们不像正片那么重要，这里就不一一赘述。

另外周边方面，黑暗王子的周边广播剧专辑 (https://vgmdb.net/album/71021) 和游戏 NADESICO THE MISSION 的 OP 动画由于无人放流，因此未作收录制作，诚邀各位老资历粉丝们补充。

Based on the BDBOX. The BDBOX source is divided into four main parts:
1. Re-scanned cel film for the TV episodes;
2. The re-scanned and additionally denoised movie;
3. The Gekiganger-themed OVA using original materials;
4. Other bonus videos.

The entire TV series has obvious, heavy dynamic noise. This preserves its authentic cel-animation look. We see this dynamic noise as the "essence" of cel-animation, so we took great care to preserve it. Since the x265 encoder doesn't handle heavy grain well, we used the more grain-friendly x264 encoder instead. We also fixed issues like residual interlacing and broken lines found throughout the series.
The movie "The prince of darkness" looks much better than the TV series, thanks to extra denoising. But if you look closely, the dynamic noise is still overwhelming. We processed it much like the TV series. Additionally, we repaired many dirty edges around the image.
The Gekiganger OVA uses the very original materials, so the image quality is extremely poor. Issues include rainbow, dot-crawl, dirty edge, severe pan, and residual interlacing. We did our best to clean it up and even added a layer of dynamic noise to make it look more consistent.
As for the other extras, each has its own set of issues. Since they are not as important as the main content, we won't elaborate on them here.

Regarding bonus contents, the drama CD album for "The prince of darkness" (https://vgmdb.net/album/71021) and the OP animation for the game "NADESICO THE MISSION" were not included due to a lack of available sources. We sincerely invite veteran fans to contribute these missing pieces.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 事与愿违的不死冒险者 / 非自愿的不死冒险者 / Nozomanu Fushi no Boukensha / 望まぬ不死の冒険者 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
大小：18.4GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




事与愿违的不死冒险者 / 非自愿的不死冒险者 / Nozomanu Fushi no Boukensha / 望まぬ不死の冒険者 BDRip

原盘画质着实不行，即使柔和的摄影和还行的编码质量也没有彻底弥补码率不足的问题，线条只要锐利一些就有不少蚊噪。好在平面上覆盖着较为均匀细腻的淡淡动噪，因此大部分场景没什么严重的色带。不过男主的第一人称不死者视角有特殊的特效，画面有相当多动噪，尤其是涉及“进化"的剧情，其视角中更是有狂暴的乱码和动噪，被低码编码后直接全损。全片原生分辨率 900，处理主要集中在改善欠码弥补锐度，以保证目视观感。不死者视角的画面我们做了分段修复，但是过于狂暴的特效我们也只能尽量保证目视效果了。
The image quality is not really good. Even the soft visuals and decent encoding could not fully make up for the lack of bitrate. Whenever lines become slightly sharper, noticeable DCT noise appears. Fortunately, the flat areas are covered by fine dynamic noise, so most scenes don't suffer from severe banding. However, the male protagonist's first-person "undead" perspective features special VFXs laden with strong dynamic noise. Particularly in scenes involving "evolution", the image is filled with chaotic VFX and intense noise, which were severely damaged by the low-bitrate encoding. The native resolution is 900. Processing mainly focused on fixing artifacts caused by insufficient bit-rate and compensating for sharpness to ensure a visual experience. For the undead perspective scenes, we performed segmented restoration, but for the overly chaotic VFXs, we could only do our best to preserve visual similarity.

item.title: [VCB-Studio] 一杆青空 / Sorairo Utility / SORA-IRO UTILITY / 空色ユーティリティ 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [TV + OVA Fin]
item.description:
大小：28.8GB
发布人：littlepox

磁力链接：magnet




一杆青空 / Sorairo Utility / SORA-IRO UTILITY / 空色ユーティリティ TV + OVA BDRip

原盘质量中等，线条问题尤其严重，制作组加入了致死量的后期锐化，造成了非常严重的晕轮问题，此外锯齿问题也时常出现。由于后期锐化，原生分辨率测试结果很不稳定，误差也非常大，难以使用逆向拉伸。最终我们选择组合多种滤镜来进行大力处理，然后通过补偿性锐化提升观感。原盘采用了先进的自适应加噪手段，在避免色带上卓有成效，不过由于原盘整体码率限制，在一些动态较高的暗场处还是存在轻度的烂噪和色带问题，对此我们采用温和的手段去除。
本作在 TV 系列播出前还曾发布过一集实验性质的 OVA 短片，本次我们一并进行了制作。由于 BD 未收录该 OVA，我们使用了 Crunchyroll 的 Web 源。OVA 与 TV 的画质差别较大，没有 TV 那惨无人道的致死量晕轮，但是原生分辨率非常不稳定，在 820~850p 之间反复横跳，此外还有 Web 码率较低导致的各种副作用。对此我们采用自适应逆向拉伸重构，配合多种常规手段尽量进行处理。

The source quality is average, with particularly severe issues on lines. The production team applied a lethal dose of sharpening in post-production, resulting in very severe haloing issues. In addition, aliasing is frequently observed. Due to the post-sharpening, the native resolution analysis results were highly unstable with large margins of error, making it difficult to utilize descaling. We eventually chose to combine multiple filters for heavy processing, followed by compensatory sharpening to improve visual presentation. The source employed advanced adaptive grain techniques, which were effective in preventing banding. However, due to the overall bitrate limitations of the source, slight grain blocking and banding still existed in some dark scenes with high motion. We addressed this using mild cleaning methods.
An experimental OVA short was released before the airing of the TV series, which we have also included in this release. Since the BD did not include this OVA, we sourced it from Crunchyroll (Web source). The image quality of the OVA differs significantly from the TV series; it lacks the inhumane, lethal amounts of haloing found in the TV version, but the native resolution is extremely unstable, fluctuating between 820p and 850p. Additionally, there are various artifacts caused by the low bitrate of the Web source. To address this, we used adaptive descaling and reconstruction, combined with various standard methods to process it as best as possible.

item.description:

大叔新人冒险者，被最强小队往死里锻炼后变无敌了 BDRip
新人大叔冒险者，被最强队伍操到死成无敌 BDRip
Shinmai Ossan Boukensha, Saikyou Party ni Shinu Hodo Kitaerarete Muteki ni Naru. BDRip
米オッサン冒険者、最強パーティに死ぬほど鍛えられて無敵になる。 S2 BDRip

原盘画质凑合，原生分辨率 812。全片可能是为了切合“大叔”的主题，画风有一种浓浓的不拘小节感：线条粗糙，动噪凌乱，明暗冲撞。虽然没给画面增添什么细节，复杂度提升不少。除此之外还有一定量的振铃和欠码。瑕疵的修复使用常规处理即可大致覆盖，但 x265 的码率效率不佳，难以在有限码率预算下还原噪点和纹理，经过调整后我们使用了 x264 进行编码。
The source quality is acceptable, with a native resolution of 812. Likely to match its "Ossan" theme, the art style carries a strong rough feel. This is reflected in coarse lines, chaotic dynamic noise, and stark light-dark contrasts. While this approach doesn't add much detail, it considerably increases the image's complexity. Additionally, there is a noticeable amount of ringing and a general lack of bitrate. These artifacts can mostly be handled with standard pre-processing. However, x265's bitrate efficiency is poor. It fails to adequately preserve noise and texture when the bitrate budget is limited. After consideration, we switched to using x264 for the encoding.

英雄教室 / Eiyuu Kyoushitsu BDRip

内封原盘 ENG 字幕。
Embedded official ENG PGS.

线条纤细，锯齿粗糙，分辨率混乱，锐度不均。由于很多锯齿是线条太细触及分辨率极限导致的，为了尽可能消除锯齿同时避免锐度损失，我们使用了多种抗锯齿算法以控制力度，并进行了补偿性锐化。当然还是有一些次像素锯齿过于锐利，加上部分线条粗细不匀，强力处理劣化严重，这部分我们只能尽力修复。最后我们削减了部分噪点以控制体积。
The lines are thin, and the aliasing appears coarse, with inconsistent native resolution and uneven sharpness. Because much of this aliasing is caused by lines that are too thin for the native resolution, we applied multiple anti-aliasing algorithms to minimize aliasing while preserving sharpness, and then followed by compensatory sharpening. However, some lines are overly sharp, making the remaining sub-pixel aliasing more noticeable. But those lines are of uneven thickness, aggressive processing would have caused huge sharpness degradation, so we can just try and fix it. Finally, we performed moderate denoising to manage the final bit-rate.

item.description:

磁力链接：magnet




魔法使的新娘 / Mahou Tsukai no Yome / 魔法使いの嫁 BDRip Reseed

魔法使的新娘 等待繁星之人 BDRip Reseed

Mahou Tsukai no Yome: Nishi no Shounen to Seiran no Kishi BDRip Reseed
魔法使いの嫁 西の少年と青嵐の騎士 BDRip Reseed

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Some episodes contain commentary tracks.

S1 & OAD1 制作说明：
魔法使的新娘蓝光画面柔和富有细节，噪点很轻，原画张数较少，原盘瑕疵几乎没有，使得使用一般的参数做出来的成品体积很小。针对这些特点，整个制作过程把修复画面瑕疵的力度降到了可以接受的最低程度，其他处理原则上尽量保持原盘画面不变，编码参数进行了一定的修改增加成品码率。

OAD2 制作说明：
原盘质量一般，原生分辨率约为 862p, 主要问题是制作方加入了过强的噪点，导致画面各处有欠码的现象。我们对线条进行了逆向拉伸重构和抗锯齿处理，调整了去色带处理的力度以适配欠码问题，并丢弃状态不佳的原盘噪点，辅以常规的补偿性锐化和自适应加噪。

S1 & OAD1:
The BD source of Mahou Tsukai no Yome possesses a soft image style and has rich details. There's little to none artifact in the source - very mild grain and fewer number of original drawings make the file size very small with regular encoding parameters. Therefore, we controlled the power of fixing artifacts to the minimum acceptable level, and other pre-processings aim to keep the original style unchanged as much as possible. We also modified the parameters to moderately increase the bit-rate.

OAD2:
The OAD is produced in approx. native 862p, with quite average image quality. The lack of bitrate is in various parts of the image due to too much grain being added during production, which is our key issue this time. To fix it, here is our pre-processing: rescaled the lines followed by anti-aliasing, adjusted the de-banding to match the insufficient bitrate, eliminated the original grains in poor condition and finally supplemented with routine compensatory sharpening and adaptive denoising.
 

重发修正：

魔法使いの嫁 西の少年と青嵐の騎士 BDRip Reseed

部分剧集内封评论音轨。
Some episodes contain commentary tracks.

S1 & OAD1 制作说明：
魔法使的新娘蓝光画面柔和富有细节，噪点很轻，原画张数较少，原盘瑕疵几乎没有，使得使用一般的参数做出来的成品体积很小。针对这些特点，整个制作过程把修复画面瑕疵的力度降到了可以接受的最低程度，其他处理原则上尽量保持原盘画面不变，编码参数进行了一定的修改增加成品码率。

OAD2 制作说明：
原盘质量一般，原生分辨率约为 862p, 主要问题是制作方加入了过强的噪点，导致画面各处有欠码的现象。我们对线条进行了逆向拉伸重构和抗锯齿处理，调整了去色带处理的力度以适配欠码问题，并丢弃状态不佳的原盘噪点，辅以常规的补偿性锐化和自适应加噪。

S1 & OAD1:
The BD source of Mahou Tsukai no Yome possesses a soft image style and has rich details. There's little to none artifact in the source - very mild grain and fewer number of original drawings make the file size very small with regular encoding parameters. Therefore, we controlled the power of fixing artifacts to the minimum acceptable level, and other pre-processings aim to keep the original style unchanged as much as possible. We also modified the parameters to moderately increase the bit-rate.

OAD2:
The OAD is produced in approx. native 862p, with quite average image quality. The lack of bitrate is in various parts of the image due to too much grain being added during production, which is our key issue this time. To fix it, here is our pre-processing: rescaled the lines followed by anti-aliasing, adjusted the de-banding to match the insufficient bitrate, eliminated the original grains in poor condition and finally supplemented with routine compensatory sharpening and adaptive denoising.
